# Vendors Directory (Unmodified Open-Source Modules)

Every open-source dependency lives unmodified inside its own subdirectory here and is excluded from Git (only `setup_vendors.ps1` and this file are tracked).

Run on Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\vendors\setup_vendors.ps1
```

Modules installed:
- `google-play-scraper/` — `https://github.com/facundoolano/google-play-scraper` (Node.js)
- `aso/` — `https://github.com/facundoolano/aso` (Node.js)
- `open-screenshot-generator/` — `https://github.com/dotnetdreamer/open-screenshot-generator`
- `detekt/` — Official `detekt-cli-*-all.jar` release from `https://github.com/detekt/detekt/releases`
